title: A solution of F′(t) = n·F(t)/t on (0,∞) satisfies F(s) = sⁿ·F(1)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let F : ℝ → ℝ be a function such that, for every t > 0, F is differentiable at t with derivative F′(t) = n·F(t)/t. Then F(s) = s^n·F(1) for every s > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasDerivAt F ((n : ℝ) * F t / t) t) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → F s = s ^ n * F 1
